title: Dataset Pruning: Reducing Training Data by Examining Generalization Influence

LIMITATIONS.absence_reason_zh: 全文没有独立局限章节，也未报告训练 seed、simulated-annealing seed/预算、有限删除近似误差、epsilon 缩放歧义或独立超参选择角色。

formulas: A subset is epsilon-redundant when the L2 distance between the full-data ERM parameter and the ERM after removing that subset is at most epsilon.
For training point z, infinitesimal parameter influence is I_param(z)=-H(theta-hat)^-1 grad_theta L(z,theta-hat), and removing a point is approximated by -I_param(z)/n.
Fixed-cardinality pruning minimizes ||W-transpose S||_2 subject to sum_i W_i=m, preserving vector direction so individually large but opposing influences may cancel.

The generalization-gap theorem is local and has an epsilon-scaling ambiguity: Algorithm 1 constrains the already 1/n-scaled vector sum, while Theorem 1 states the constraint on an unscaled sum before deriving an epsilon/n term.
algorithm_steps: Train an empirical-risk minimizer on the full dataset from a random initialization.
Approximate every training point's parameter influence using an inverse-Hessian product, implemented on the last linear layer.
Solve a binary discrete optimization with simulated annealing either to maximize removable count under an aggregate-vector norm threshold or minimize aggregate norm at fixed count.
Remove the selected identities, initialize a fresh model, and retrain it on the retained dataset under a common training protocol.
Evaluate final accuracy, convergence time, architecture transfer, and proxy-set NAS rank correlation.
variables: dataset D, removed subset D-hat, retained dataset, cardinality m, and binary selector W
full-data parameters theta-hat, removed-data parameters theta-hat-minus-D-hat, and threshold epsilon
per-sample gradient, Hessian H, parameter influence I_param, and stacked influence matrix S
pruning ratio, simulated-annealing state, proxy architecture, and retraining initialization
test accuracy, convergence time, Spearman architecture rank correlation, storage, and approximation residual
selection_timing: Selection is one-shot after fitting a proxy ERM; the chosen removed/retained IDs are fixed before a separate model is retrained from scratch.
refresh_rule: No online refresh is defined. A new proxy checkpoint, architecture, subset size, epsilon, or annealing seed implies a new discrete optimization and selected set.

budget.unit: unique training identities removed or retained
budget.unique_sample_definition: Each training identity has one binary removal variable; class, source, and video coverage are not explicit constraints.
budget.repeat_definition: Retained examples repeat through ordinary retraining epochs; removed examples have zero exposure, but per-ID repeat counts are not recorded.
budget.cumulative_exposure_definition: Methods share a pruning ratio and nominal 200-epoch retraining protocol, yet actual convergence and optimizer-visible exposure differ from full data and are not matched as replay dose.
budget.compute_cost: Influence uses approximate inverse-Hessian products on the last layer plus an unreported simulated-annealing budget; the selected coreset can reduce later repeated training or NAS cost.

random_baselines: uniform random pruning at the same expected number of identities
individual influence-function norm without group interaction
checkpoint_selection: The paper does not specify an independent validation rule for the proxy checkpoint, epsilon, pruning ratio, simulated-annealing configuration, or retrained checkpoint; no test-oracle-safe selection contract is reported.

results.claim: 集合向量优化在较高 pruning ratio 下相对单样本 scalar baselines 的差距扩大。
results.value: The paper reports the proposed method consistently above baselines, with Forgetting and EL2N close only at small pruning ratios and influence-norm performing poorly at larger ratios; plot-level per-seed values are not supplied.

ablations: uniform random, Herding, Forgetting, GraNd, EL2N, and individual influence norm
negative_results: The 40% coreset trades roughly half convergence time for a reported 1.3-point accuracy loss rather than a uniform gain.
Individual influence norm performs poorly relative to aggregate-vector optimization at larger pruning ratios.
Random 2% NAS proxy reduces compute strongly but fails to preserve architecture rank and final performance.
No variance or seed-level results support the claimed consistency across pruning ratios or architectures.
The local influence approximation, epsilon scaling, and simulated-annealing convergence are not empirically stress-tested.
failure_conditions: The Hessian is singular or the last-layer local linearization poorly approximates finite data removal.
The epsilon convention changes by a factor of n between collector, optimizer, theorem, and report.
Simulated annealing returns unstable sets across unrecorded seed, schedule, or compute budget.
Global parameter cancellation hides one component that helps normal-tail targets and another that harms weak defects.
Source/video duplicates, label noise, or rare target-domain groups are absent from the optimization constraints.
limitations: Removing data and retraining from scratch is not repeated replay inside a fixed optimizer trajectory.
Parameter proximity and average expected loss do not guarantee an FN95 local safety frontier.
The guarantee relies on local Taylor expansion, positive-definite Hessian assumptions, additive infinitesimal influences, and unstated constants.
The epsilon scaling is ambiguous between Algorithm 1 and Theorem 1.
Seed counts, uncertainty intervals, annealing details, public code, and exact experiment manifests are absent.
Nominal subset size does not match cumulative optimizer-visible exposure or steps.
stage1_mechanism_zh: 该文直接支持 D 必须在集合条件下检查向量和、sum-of-norms、pairwise cosine、cancellation ratio、来源覆盖和有限干预残差；单样本 gradient/influence 模长会丢失方向与抵消。Stage1 还必须分别计算 normal-tail 与 weak-defect 方向，不能用一个全局参数距离抵消好坏。
stage1_non_inference_zh: 论文不能证明 Dataset-Pruning 或 influence 集合会提高 replay utility：它删除数据并重新训练，未固定基础训练过程、累计 replay 曝光、unique/repeat/steps，也没有 FN95 目标、R1/R2/current-loss/no-replay 或未见 seed 配对。其 epsilon、pruning ratio 和 simulated annealing 均不得直接移植。
